title: Factory Maintenance Scheduling
body:
A factory has n machines. Machine i produces o_i units on day 1 and then again every c_i days (on days 1, 1 + c_i, 1 + 2c_i, …), because it needs maintenance in between. So within the first D days it produces o_i · ceil(D / c_i) units.

Find the smallest number of days D after which the total production is at least P.

The report's sample only fits this reading (the literal "produce, then c_i days off" cycle gives 23, not 21).

Function to complete

Complete minDays(P, output, cooldown). It returns the minimum number of days.

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: Line 1: P n. Line 2: o_1 … o_n. Line 3: c_1 … c_n.
out: One integer: the minimum number of days.

samples.ex: After 20 days the machines have made 4 + 4 + 3 + 2 + 3 + 4 = 20 units; after 21 days, 23.

ref:
class Solution:
    def minDays(self, P: int, output: List[int], cooldown: List[int]) -> int:
        o, c, n = output, cooldown, len(output)
        def ok(D): return sum(o[i] * (-(-D // c[i])) for i in range(n)) >= P
        lo = hi = 1
        while not ok(hi): hi *= 2
        while lo < hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if ok(mid): hi = mid
            else: lo = mid + 1
        return lo
